content.short: BoltRPC is a dedicated RPC provider with fixed request weights and predictable flat pricing.
content.description: Its distinguishing choice is pricing: fixed request-unit weights and a flat monthly fee rather than metered billing that varies with how expensive each call happens to be. That predictability matters to teams whose infrastructure bill would otherwise swing with user behaviour.
